title: FitMetrics — Offline-First Health & Fitness Tracker App
problem: Fitness enthusiasts and athletes needed a comprehensive, ultra-fast workout & health calculator app that functions 100% offline in basements/gyms without latency, tracking 12+ health metrics and workouts.
solution: Engineered a high-performance cross-platform app in React Native & Expo with local SQLite engine, Zustand state management, dynamic rest timers with background vibration/audio, AI workout advice, barcode scanner nutrition log, RevenueCat subscription gating, and Google AdMob monetization.
outcome: Production release built with sub-50ms launch time, zero server latency, 176/176 automated test coverage, and complete Play Store compliance.

title: FitMetrics Official App Showcase & Marketing Platform
problem: Mobile apps need a high-converting, SEO-optimized web landing page with live interactive calculator demonstrations to convert web visitors into active mobile app downloads.
solution: Designed and deployed a responsive, dark-mode glassmorphic web application with interactive calculator previews (BMI, BMR, TDEE, Body Fat), Google Play store badges, feature breakdowns, and FAQ schema.
outcome: 100/100 Google Lighthouse performance score, zero bundle overhead, sub-second page loads, and seamless Netlify automated deployment.

title: FitMetrics Privacy & Account Deletion Compliance Portal
problem: Google Play Store's 2026 developer policies mandate that all apps supporting account creation must provide a dedicated public web URL for account and data deletion requests.
solution: Developed an end-to-end GDPR/Google Play compliant web portal featuring an intuitive data deletion request flow, clear policy declarations, and support contact routing.
outcome: 100% compliance with Google Play Store Safety & Data Governance requirements, preventing policy strikes and enabling immediate app approvals.

title: Automated Playwright Store Screenshot & Promo Graphics Suite
problem: Creating 15+ localized, high-resolution Play Store promotional graphics with 3D device mockups, feature titles, and gradients took hours of manual designer effort per release.
solution: Programmed an automated headless Playwright rendering engine that captures responsive app views, applies device bezels and typography overlays, and exports pixel-perfect 1080x1920 Play Store assets.
outcome: Cut release marketing asset generation time from 4 hours to under 5 seconds with 100% automated repeatable accuracy across all app themes.

title: AI-Powered SaaS Invoice & Billing Automation
problem: Growing businesses lost hours manually typing paper receipts, creating invoices, and chasing unpaid client bills.
solution: Built a full-stack Next.js web application with AI receipt OCR parsing, automated Stripe subscription billing, and PDF export.
outcome: Reduced manual invoice entry by 80% and automated payment tracking across hundreds of active client accounts.

title: Real-Time Health & Fitness Analytics Portal
problem: Health coaches needed a central interactive dashboard to monitor client fitness progression, macro targets, and body metrics.
solution: Constructed an interactive React web dashboard featuring responsive charts, CSV/PDF report generation, and instant filtering.
outcome: Streamlined client consultations and provided instant progress tracking for coaches managing multi-client portfolios.
